title: 防災のイラスト
subject_en: disaster-prevention pictogram icons, each a separate object, bold and clear, no text Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 防災リュック、ヘルメット、懐中電灯、ラジオ、非常食など、防災の備えを表す12点。ポスターや回覧に。
items: a first-aid box with a plain cross
a simple pictogram of a person running to an exit door
a folded map with a location pin
a power bank with a cable
